findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "klyo_publish_game" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?profil=gry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: klyo_publish_game, klyo_upload_package, klyo_release_version, klyo_delete_game, klyo_game_scaffold, klyo_game_diagnostics, klyo_game_patch, klyo_add_post · Private data: klyo_publish_game, klyo_upload_package, klyo_update_game, klyo_release_rollback, klyo_release_version, klyo_delete_game, klyo_game_analytics, klyo_game_requirements, klyo_game_scaffold, klyo_game_sdk, klyo_fix_game, klyo_game_diagnostics, klyo_game_files, klyo_game_patch, klyo_game_play · Public sink: klyo_publish_game, klyo_upload_package, klyo_update_game, klyo_delete_game, klyo_game_stats, klyo_game_requirements, klyo_game_patch, klyo_game_play, klyo_game_translate, klyo_fill_game_form, klyo_add_post · Destructive: klyo_release_rollback, klyo_delete_game, klyo_game_diagnostics, klyo_game_patch, klyo_game_play.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
